title: Design: No blue line while the name is not allowed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is active.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p3-03-validation-errors.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type "net 30" in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • Name reads "net 30".

Step 3:

  • Under Name the red message "Net 30 is already a standard term. Pick another name." shows, the Days box has no error, and no blue explanation line shows (design note: "No sentence shows while a field is invalid.").

Step 4:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Held: the design's behaviour; under the PRD the blue line shows because the number is valid. Released or deleted when question 10 is answered (register CT-D03).
